title: The Journey Begins
intro: After months of planning, the journey finally starts in Fort Worth. From Texas, I head to Detroit before boarding the overnight flight across the Atlantic to Munich.

stops.name: Fort Worth
stops.description: The journey begins at home in Fort Worth, Texas.

stops.name: Detroit
stops.description: Connect in Detroit before the overnight transatlantic flight.

stops.name: Munich
stops.description: Arrive in Germany the following morning, where the European road trip begins.
